stories.title: パラマウント、ワーナーの17兆円買収完了 新社名「スカイダンス」

en.title: Paramount completes 1.7 trillion yen acquisition of Warner, new company name "Skydance"
en.summary: Paramount has completed its acquisition of Warner for 1.7 trillion yen, with the combined entity operating under the new name Skydance.

stories.title: 旭化成子会社でも個人情報漏洩か 医療関係者向けサイトにサイバー攻撃、最大55万人超

en.title: Asahi Kasei subsidiary also experiences personal information breach; healthcare professional website hit by cyberattack, potentially affecting over 550,000 people
en.summary: A pharmaceutical subsidiary of Asahi Kasei reported that a cyberattack on its healthcare professional website resulted in potential exposure of personal information for approximately 558,700 individuals. The company stated no unauthorized use of the data has been confirmed so far.

stories.title: 米中、核施設の相互視察を非公式に協議か 軍拡競争懸念、信頼醸成につなげる狙い

en.title: US and China reportedly holding informal talks on mutual nuclear facility inspections; aimed at building trust amid arms race concerns
en.summary: According to CNN sources, the United States and China have begun informal discussions on the possibility of mutual inspections of nuclear facilities, intended to build confidence as concerns over China's rapid nuclear expansion grow. China has previously resisted new nuclear disarmament frameworks.

stories.title: 男子73キロ級の田中龍雅、女子57キロ級の大森朱莉がともに初出場V 世界柔道第3日

en.title: Tanaka Ryuga in men's 73kg class and Omori Akari in women's 57kg class both win on debut; World Judo Championship Day 3
en.summary: At the World Judo Championship in Baku, Tanaka Ryuga, 22, won the men's 73kg title on his first appearance, while Omori Akari claimed victory in the women's 57kg division, with Tanaka becoming Japan's first champion in his weight class since 2019.

stories.title: 【第31回釜山国際映画祭】沢尻エリカ、総額約6000万円ジュエリー＆美脚で魅了 W主演・丸山隆平が優しくエスコート

en.title: [31st Busan International Film Festival] Erika Sawajiri captivates with approximately 60 million yen in jewelry and beautiful legs; co-star Ryuhei Maruyama escorts her graciously
en.summary: Actors Ryuhei Maruyama and Erika Sawajiri appeared on the red carpet of the 31st Busan International Film Festival in South Korea, where they are co-starring in the film "Chain of Roses." Maruyama wore a black suit while Sawajiri wore a black minidress that showcased her legs.

stories.title: パ・リーグ、総観客動員数で史上最多を更新 チーム別では優勝のソフトバンクが最多

en.title: Pacific League achieves record total attendance, with champion SoftBank drawing the most
en.summary: The Pacific League completed its regular season with total attendance of approximately 12.55 million, surpassing the previous record from last year. Champion SoftBank recorded the highest attendance among individual teams.

stories.title: 米国の8月貿易赤字、13.7％増 2カ月連続拡大、対メキシコ・ベトナムは過去最大更新

en.title: U.S. August trade deficit increases 13.7%, marking second consecutive expansion with Mexico and Vietnam deficits reaching record highs
en.summary: The U.S. trade deficit for August reached 105.6 billion dollars, up 13.7 percent from the previous month. The deficit with Mexico and Vietnam both reached their highest levels on record.

stories.title: 桑田佳祐×あいみょん「なごり雪」配信開始 ライブアルバム『九段下フォーク・フェスティバル'25』発売カウントダウン企画

en.title: Yoshihiro Kuwata and Aimyon release "Nagori Yuki"; countdown campaign for live album "Kudan-shita Folk Festival '25"
en.summary: A charity live album from the Kudan-shita Folk Festival held at Nippon Budokan last autumn will be released on November 3 to support relief efforts for natural disasters across Japan. Selected songs will be released weekly starting today through a countdown promotion.

stories.title: ルビオ米国務長官、アイスランド首相と北極圏で安保懸念の共有図る 中露の影響力踏まえ

en.title: US Secretary of State Rubio seeks shared security concerns with Iceland's Prime Minister in Arctic
en.summary: US Secretary of State Rubio met with Iceland's Prime Minister Frostadóttir in Reykjavik to reaffirm defense cooperation. According to US media, Rubio sought to share concerns about Arctic security in light of expanding Russian and Chinese influence.

stories.title: 挑戦者精神「忘れてはいけない」 ノーベル物理学賞貢献の千葉大教授語る研究参加時の覚悟

en.title: Chiba University professor involved in Nobel Physics Prize-winning research emphasizes importance of challenger spirit
en.summary: A Chiba University professor who contributed to the international IceCube project, this year's Nobel Physics Prize recipient, stated that the research began despite being viewed as reckless and emphasized the importance of taking risks in scientific endeavors.

en.title: "Haven't forgotten" - knitting event supports Gaza at Shojoji Temple
en.summary: An event using knitting to support the Gaza region was held at Shojoji Temple.

stories.title: 韓国、駐ウクライナ大使の召還含め検討 外交摩擦で謝罪メッセージ受け取るも不十分と認識

en.title: South Korea considers recalling ambassador to Ukraine amid diplomatic friction over North Korean prisoners
en.summary: South Korea's foreign minister stated that Ukraine sent an apology message regarding the transfer of two North Korean prisoners, but deemed it insufficient. South Korea plans to take firm measures including potentially recalling its ambassador to Ukraine.

stories.title: China's DeepSeek, peers launch 16 AI models in month despite Anthropic warning

en.title: China's DeepSeek, peers launch 16 AI models in month despite Anthropic warning
en.summary: Chinese AI companies, including DeepSeek, released 16 artificial intelligence models within a month. This development occurred despite cautionary statements from Anthropic regarding rapid AI model deployment.

en.title: China's passion for Japan arts behind record-smashing tea bowl auction
en.summary: A Japanese tea bowl sold at auction for a record price, driven by strong demand from Chinese collectors with interest in Japanese arts and craftsmanship.

en.title: Taiwan's AUO, Innolux bet on glass as next-gen AI chip material
en.summary: Taiwanese companies AUO and Innolux are investing in glass as a material for manufacturing next-generation artificial intelligence computer chips.

en.title: Honda, Nissan each team with US AI startup on next-gen vehicle software
en.summary: Honda and Nissan have separately partnered with American artificial intelligence startups to develop software for next-generation vehicles.

stories.title: Malaysia's Top Glove triples net profit despite high material costs

en.title: Malaysia's Top Glove triples net profit despite high material costs
en.summary: Top Glove, a Malaysian company, significantly increased its net profit to three times its previous level while managing elevated expenses for raw materials.
